title: Exclude WorkIQ feature key from demo data feature enablement
summary: Demo data tools no longer enable the new platform WorkIQ feature key (Allow WorkIQ to read data from Business Central). It stays an explicit admin opt-in through Feature Management.
key_points: WorkIQ added to the existing ExcludeNewFeature lists in the demo data codeunits
Applied to the Contoso Coffee demo dataset and the W1, CZ and IN DemoTool layers
Joins already excluded keys such as PowerAutomateCopilot, FullTextSearch, AdvancedTellMe and SemanticMetadataSearch
Admins can still turn WorkIQ on from Feature Management
